source_review.notes: Checked Springer, ACM, SIAM, Algorithmica, Foundations and Trends, Berkeley-hosted primary-paper, author, and institutional records for B-trees, external-memory search, buffer trees, LSM trees, string indexes, cache-oblivious B-trees, modern B-tree techniques, and learned index structures. Historical device measurements are not presented as current performance.

evidence: Checked entry count, page geometry, usable capacity, leaf capacity, fanout, leaf count, levels, range size, transfer, and amplification notation.
Checked key/separator/fence, logical/physical, cold/warm, fixed/variable, unique/duplicate, snapshot/update, and visible/durable distinctions.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Page levels and logical visits are not conflated with cached or physical device requests.

evidence: Recomputed fanout, leaf and internal page counts, tree levels, occupancy redistribution, duplicate pages, and write-amplification examples.
Checked 2,400 bounded index configurations and 151,200 present/absent point queries against an independent arithmetic oracle.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Fanout examples are encoding estimates and explicitly reserve variable-format qualifications.

evidence: Re-derived leaf count, height, point and range transfer forms, fanout inequality, and geometric bottom-up build cost.
Re-derived separator routing and bottom-up reachability from disjoint consecutive ranges.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The logarithmic bounds remain attached to eligible page-capacity and external-memory assumptions.

evidence: Checked single-leaf, partial-tail, underfilled-tail, separator equality, minimum, maximum, absent gaps, duplicates, giant keys, overflow values, and variable fanout.
Checked unsorted input, comparator drift, stale generations, checksum mismatch, interrupted child/root writes, compaction stalls, tombstones, cached roots, and adversarial learned-model error.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Query samples and checksums are explicitly rejected as full coverage or ordering evidence.

evidence: All bounded present and absent lookups obeyed the minimum-right separator convention.
Reviewed leaf order, exact snapshot coverage, child-range coverage, occupancy, leaf-chain coherence, page generation, durability, publication, and reclamation invariants.
invariant_checking.notes: The executable uses unique immutable keys and is not evidence for duplicate, update, or crash behavior.

evidence: Reviewed induction that separator routing preserves the candidate interval through one child per level.
Reviewed disjoint bottom-up page coverage, geometric level size, and children-before-parent publication reasoning.
proof_review.notes: Amortized buffered-update claims are separated from worst-case latency.

evidence: Audited bound, estimate, invariant, proof, amortized, expected, cold, cached, durable, atomic, and verified language.
Separated index semantics, abstract page mechanism, encoded layout, storage protocol, and measured behavior.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No filesystem, storage service, or cache behavior is asserted universally.

evidence: The CPython 3.14.4 snippet produced five leaves, three levels, correct found/absent results, and 20 ordered entries on macOS 13.7.8 x86_64.
Independent bounded testing checked 151,200 queries across 2,400 capacity/fanout/data-size configurations.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Execution does not create storage pages or establish I/O, byte occupancy, durability, concurrency, recovery, latency, or production performance.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed semantics, page geometry, height, separators, bottom-up construction, ranges, buffered updates, alternative organizations, crash-safe publication, and complete-index audit.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed variable encodings, duplicate runs, fill reserve, overflow values, page generations, checksums, root publication, reclamation, caching, read-ahead, compaction, tail latency, and logical/physical metrics.

pedagogical_review.notes: The Level-II chapter derives search and construction geometry, executes separator routing, connects correctness to persistence, supplies ten distinct examples, and ends with five progressive exercises and complete answers.

limitations: Internal source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical review only; no external academic, database, storage, filesystem, performance, security, or operational review is claimed. Conclusions remain conditional on snapshot, comparator, duplicates, key/value encoding, page geometry, fanout, memory, caching, storage, workload, update, transaction, concurrency, durability, recovery, compiler, toolchain, and system assumptions.
